head_commit.message:
perf: preserve full XML guards with cheaper descriptor checks

Use canonical native descriptor shapes without skipping keys, prototypes, flags or SameValue checks. Retain per-task integrity checks and all budgets; regenerate the pinned XML bundle. Add thirty QuickJS adversarial cases and preserve all third-run failures plus profiling and 94-test evidence.
